pediatricPearls: Use pediatric dosing of medications or electrical therapy for a pediatric patient < 37 kg and as defined by HandTevy.
Fluids and Medication titrated to maintain a SBP >70 + (age in years x 2) mmHg

pl1: Control external hemorrhage and apply tourniquet(s) as necessary, including junctional tourniquets if needed and available.
Wound packing (junctional/extremity) with pressure dressing as appropriate and apply Quick Clot Combat Gauze if available
Elevate head of bed 30⁰ unless cardiac arrest or step-offs noted in C-spine
Place occlusive dressing/chest seal over open pneumothorax
Evaluate for spinal motion restriction – Do not transport laying on long spine board
pl2: Bandage/splint injuries as appropriate for patient condition
Declare Trauma Alert / Activation if appropriate for patient condition
Ibuprofen for musculoskeletal and/or joint pain/injury
Acetaminophen (all routes) – IV Acetaminophen only if MAP > 65
Adult: Isotonic Crystalloid IV bolus 250 mL if patient shows signs of shock; Pediatric 20 mL/kg as needed
pl3: Needle decompression of the chest as indicated
Pain management – Fentanyl and/or Ketamine as indicated.
If Adult Spinal Shock – Norepinephrine (Levophed) Infusion titrated to MAP > 65
Blood Product Transfusion and Calcium Chloride
pl4: Escharotomy as indicated for ventilation compliance
